family.description: This domain is found at the N-terminal of Magnetotaxis protein MtxA from Magnetospirillum gryphiswaldense ([swissprot:A4TUL6]) and similar sequences from magnetotactic aquatic proteobacteria. Magnetotaxis is believed to direct the swimming of cells toward growth-favoring microoxic zones in natural waters [[cite:PUB00154088]].
family.name: Magnetotaxis protein MtxA, N-terminal domain
